content.english: 92:1 For he hath established the world * which shall not be moved.

segments.t: Étenim firmávit orbem terræ, * qui non commovébitur.

content.latin: 92:2 Paráta sedes tua ex tunc: * a sǽculo tu es.
content.english: 92:2 Thy throne is prepared from of old: * thou art from everlasting.

segments.t: Paráta sedes tua ex tunc: * a sǽculo tu es.

content.latin: 92:3 Elevavérunt flúmina, Dómine: * elevavérunt flúmina vocem suam.
content.english: 92:3 The floods have lifted up, O Lord: * the floods have lifted up their voice.

segments.t: Elevavérunt flúmina, Dómine: * elevavérunt flúmina vocem suam.

content.latin: 92:3 Elevavérunt flúmina fluctus suos, * a vócibus aquárum multárum.
content.english: 92:3 The floods have lifted up their waves, * with the noise of many waters.

segments.t: Elevavérunt flúmina fluctus suos, * a vócibus aquárum multárum.

content.latin: 92:4 Mirábiles elatiónes maris: * mirábilis in altis Dóminus.
content.english: 92:4 Wonderful are the surges of the sea: * wonderful is the Lord on high.

segments.t: Mirábiles elatiónes maris: * mirábilis in altis Dóminus.

content.latin: 92:5 Testimónia tua credibília facta sunt nimis: * domum tuam decet sanctitúdo, Dómine, in longitúdinem diérum.
content.english: 92:5 Thy testimonies are become exceedingly credible: * holiness becometh thy house, O Lord, unto length of days.

segments.t: Testimónia tua credibília facta sunt nimis: * domum tuam decet sanctitúdo, Dómine, in longitúdinem diérum.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Quem vidístis, pastóres? dícite, annuntiáte nobis, in terris quis appáruit? Natum vídimus, et choros Angelórum collaudántes Dóminum, allelúia, allelúia.
content.english: Ant. O ye shepherds, speak, and tell us what ye have seen; who is appeared in the earth? We saw the newborn Child, and angels singing praise to the Lord, alleluia, alleluia.

segments.t: Ant.
Quem vidístis, pastóres? dícite, annuntiáte nobis, in terris quis appáruit? Natum vídimus, et choros Angelórum collaudántes Dóminum, allelúia, allelúia.

content.latin: Ant. Génuit puérpera * Regem, cui nomen ætérnum, et gáudia matris habens cum virginitátis honóre: nec primam símilem visa est, nec habére sequéntem, allelúia.
content.english: Ant. The Mother brought forth the King, * Whose name is called The Eternal; the joy of a Mother was hers, remaining a Virgin unsullied; neither before nor henceforth hath there been or shall be such another, alleluia.

segments.t: Ant.
Génuit puérpera * Regem, cui nomen ætérnum, et gáudia matris habens cum virginitátis honóre: nec primam símilem visa est, nec habére sequéntem, allelúia.

content.latin: Psalmus 99 [2]
content.english: Psalm 99 [2]

segments.t: Psalmus 99

content.latin: 99:2 Iubiláte Deo, omnis terra: * servíte Dómino in lætítia.
content.english: 99:2 Sing joyfully to God, all the earth: * serve ye the Lord with gladness.

segments.t: Iubiláte Deo, omnis terra: * servíte Dómino in lætítia.

content.latin: 99:2 Introíte in conspéctu eius, * in exsultatióne.
content.english: 99:2 Come in before his presence * with exceeding great joy.

segments.t: Introíte in conspéctu eius, * in exsultatióne.

content.latin: 99:3 Scitóte quóniam Dóminus ipse est Deus: * ipse fecit nos, et non ipsi nos.
content.english: 99:3 Know ye that the Lord he is God: * he made us, and not we ourselves.

segments.t: Scitóte quóniam Dóminus ipse est Deus: * ipse fecit nos, et non ipsi nos.

content.latin: 99:3 Pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius: * introíte portas eius in confessióne, átria eius in hymnis: confitémini illi.
content.english: 99:3 We are his people and the sheep of his pasture. * Go ye into his gates with praise, into his courts with hymns: and give glory to him.

segments.t: Pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius: * introíte portas eius in confessióne, átria eius in hymnis: confitémini illi.

content.latin: 99:4 Laudáte nomen eius: quóniam suávis est Dóminus, in ætérnum misericórdia eius, * et usque in generatiónem et generatiónem véritas eius.
content.english: 99:4 Praise ye his name: for the Lord is sweet, his mercy endureth for ever, * and his truth to generation and generation.

segments.t: Laudáte nomen eius: quóniam suávis est Dóminus, in ætérnum misericórdia eius, * et usque in generatiónem et generatiónem véritas eius.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.english: Ant. The Mother brought forth the King, Whose name is called The Eternal; the joy of a Mother was hers, remaining a Virgin unsullied; neither before nor henceforth hath there been or shall be such another, alleluia.

segments.t: Ant.
Génuit puérpera Regem, cui nomen ætérnum, et gáudia matris habens cum virginitátis honóre: nec primam símilem visa est, nec habére sequéntem, allelúia.

content.latin: Ant. Angelus ad pastóres * ait: Annúntio vobis gáudium magnum: quia natus est vobis hódie Salvátor mundi, allelúia.
content.english: Ant. The Angel said unto the shepherds * I bring you good tidings of great joy; for unto you is born this day a Saviour of the world, alleluia.

segments.t: Ant.
Angelus ad pastóres * ait: Annúntio vobis gáudium magnum: quia natus est vobis hódie Salvátor mundi, allelúia.

content.latin: Psalmus 62 [3]
content.english: Psalm 62 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 62

content.latin: 62:2 Deus, Deus meus, * ad te de luce vígilo.
content.english: 62:2 O God, my God, * to thee do I watch at break of day.

segments.t: Deus, Deus meus, * ad te de luce vígilo.

content.latin: 62:2 Sitívit in te ánima mea, * quam multiplíciter tibi caro mea.
content.english: 62:2 For thee my soul hath thirsted; * for thee my flesh, O how many ways!

segments.t: Sitívit in te ánima mea, * quam multiplíciter tibi caro mea.

content.latin: 62:3 In terra desérta, et ínvia, et inaquósa: * sic in sancto appárui tibi, ut vidérem virtútem tuam, et glóriam tuam.
content.english: 62:3 In a desert land, and where there is no way, and no water: * so in the sanctuary have I come before thee, to see thy power and thy glory.

segments.t: In terra desérta, et ínvia, et inaquósa: * sic in sancto appárui tibi, ut vidérem virtútem tuam, et glóriam tuam.

content.latin: 62:4 Quóniam mélior est misericórdia tua super vitas: * lábia mea laudábunt te.
content.english: 62:4 For thy mercy is better than lives: * thee my lips shall praise.

segments.t: Quóniam mélior est misericórdia tua super vitas: * lábia mea laudábunt te.

content.latin: 62:5 Sic benedícam te in vita mea: * et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas.
content.english: 62:5 Thus will I bless thee all my life long: * and in thy name I will lift up my hands.

segments.t: Sic benedícam te in vita mea: * et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas.

content.latin: 62:6 Sicut ádipe et pinguédine repleátur ánima mea: * et lábiis exsultatiónis laudábit os meum.
content.english: 62:6 Let my soul be filled as with marrow and fatness: * and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips.

segments.t: Sicut ádipe et pinguédine repleátur ánima mea: * et lábiis exsultatiónis laudábit os meum.

content.latin: 62:7 Si memor fui tui super stratum meum, in matutínis meditábor in te: * quia fuísti adiútor meus.
content.english: 62:7 If I have remembered thee upon my bed, I will meditate on thee in the morning: * because thou hast been my helper.

segments.t: Si memor fui tui super stratum meum, in matutínis meditábor in te: * quia fuísti adiútor meus.

content.latin: 62:8 Et in velaménto alárum tuárum exsultábo, adhǽsit ánima mea post te: * me suscépit déxtera tua.
content.english: 62:8 And I will rejoice under the covert of thy wings: my soul hath stuck close to thee: * thy right hand hath received me.

segments.t: Et in velaménto alárum tuárum exsultábo, adhǽsit ánima mea post te: * me suscépit déxtera tua.

content.latin: 62:10 Ipsi vero in vanum quæsiérunt ánimam meam, introíbunt in inferióra terræ: * tradéntur in manus gládii, partes vúlpium erunt.
content.english: 62:10 But they have sought my soul in vain, they shall go into the lower parts of the earth: * they shall be delivered into the hands of the sword, they shall be the portions of foxes.

segments.t: Ipsi vero in vanum quæsiérunt ánimam meam, introíbunt in inferióra terræ: * tradéntur in manus gládii, partes vúlpium erunt.

content.latin: 62:12 Rex vero lætábitur in Deo, laudabúntur omnes qui iurant in eo: * quia obstrúctum est os loquéntium iníqua.
content.english: 62:12 But the king shall rejoice in God, all they shall be praised that swear by him: * because the mouth is stopped of them that speak wicked things.

segments.t: Rex vero lætábitur in Deo, laudabúntur omnes qui iurant in eo: * quia obstrúctum est os loquéntium iníqua.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

Angelus ad pastóres ait: Annúntio vobis gáudium magnum: quia natus est vobis hódie Salvátor mundi, allelúia.

content.latin: Ant. Facta est cum Angelo * multitúdo cæléstis exércitus laudántium Deum, et dicéntium: Glória in excélsis Deo, et in terra pax homínibus bonæ voluntátis, allelúia.
content.english: Ant. There was with the Angel a multitude of the heavenly host, * praising God, and saying Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, to men of good will, alleluia.

content.latin: Canticum Trium Puerorum [4]
content.english: Canticle of the Three Young Men [4]

segments.t: Canticum Trium Puerorum

content.latin: 3:57 Benedícite, ómnia ópera Dómini, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:57 All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: Benedícite, ómnia ópera Dómini, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:58 Benedícite, Ángeli Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, cæli, Dómino.
content.english: 3:58 O ye angels of the Lord, bless the Lord: * O ye heavens, bless the Lord:

segments.t: Benedícite, Ángeli Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, cæli, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:59 Benedícite, aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes virtútes Dómini, Dómino.
content.english: 3:59 O all ye waters that are above the heavens, bless the Lord: * O all ye powers of the Lord, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes virtútes Dómini, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:60 Benedícite, sol et luna, Dómino: * benedícite, stellæ cæli, Dómino.
content.english: 3:60 O ye sun and moon, bless the Lord: * O ye stars of heaven, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, sol et luna, Dómino: * benedícite, stellæ cæli, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:61 Benedícite, omnis imber et ros, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes spíritus Dei, Dómino.
content.english: 3:61 O every shower and dew, bless ye the Lord: * O all ye spirits of God, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, omnis imber et ros, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes spíritus Dei, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:62 Benedícite, ignis et æstus, Dómino: * benedícite, frigus et æstus, Dómino.
content.english: 3:62 O ye fire and heat, bless the Lord: * O ye cold and heat, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, ignis et æstus, Dómino: * benedícite, frigus et æstus, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:63 Benedícite, rores et pruína, Dómino: * benedícite, gelu et frigus, Dómino.
content.english: 3:63 O ye dews and hoar frosts, bless the Lord: * O ye frost and cold, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, rores et pruína, Dómino: * benedícite, gelu et frigus, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:64 Benedícite, glácies et nives, Dómino: * benedícite, noctes et dies, Dómino.
content.english: 3:64 O ye ice and snow, bless the Lord: * O ye nights and days, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, glácies et nives, Dómino: * benedícite, noctes et dies, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:65 Benedícite, lux et ténebræ, Dómino: * benedícite, fúlgura et nubes, Dómino.
content.english: 3:65 O ye light and darkness, bless the Lord: * O ye lightnings and clouds, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, lux et ténebræ, Dómino: * benedícite, fúlgura et nubes, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:66 Benedícat terra Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:66 O let the earth bless the Lord: * let it praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: Benedícat terra Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:67 Benedícite, montes et colles, Dómino: * benedícite, univérsa germinántia in terra, Dómino.
content.english: 3:67 O ye mountains and hills, bless the Lord: * O all ye things that spring up in the earth, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, montes et colles, Dómino: * benedícite, univérsa germinántia in terra, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:68 Benedícite, fontes, Dómino: * benedícite, mária et flúmina, Dómino.
content.english: 3:68 O ye fountains, bless the Lord: * O ye seas and rivers, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, fontes, Dómino: * benedícite, mária et flúmina, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:69 Benedícite, cete, et ómnia, quæ movéntur in aquis, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes vólucres cæli, Dómino.
content.english: 3:69 O ye whales, and all that move in the waters, bless the Lord: * O all ye fowls of the air, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, cete, et ómnia, quæ movéntur in aquis, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes vólucres cæli, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:70 Benedícite, omnes béstiæ et pécora, Dómino: * benedícite, fílii hóminum, Dómino.
content.english: 3:70 O all ye beasts and cattle, bless the Lord: * O ye sons of men, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, omnes béstiæ et pécora, Dómino: * benedícite, fílii hóminum, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:71 Benedícat Israël Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:71 O let Israel bless the Lord: * let them praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: Benedícat Israël Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:72 Benedícite, sacerdótes Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, servi Dómini, Dómino.
content.english: 3:72 O ye priests of the Lord, bless the Lord: * O ye servants of the Lord, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, sacerdótes Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, servi Dómini, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:73 Benedícite, spíritus, et ánimæ iustórum, Dómino: * benedícite, sancti, et húmiles corde, Dómino.
content.english: 3:73 O ye spirits and souls of the just, bless the Lord: * O ye holy and humble of heart, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, spíritus, et ánimæ iustórum, Dómino: * benedícite, sancti, et húmiles corde, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:74 Benedícite, Ananía, Azaría, Mísaël, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:74 O Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, bless ye the Lord: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: Benedícite, Ananía, Azaría, Mísaël, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:75 (Fit reverentia:) Benedicámus Patrem et Fílium cum Sancto Spíritu: * laudémus et superexaltémus eum in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:75 (Bow head) Let us bless the Father and the Son, with the Holy Ghost; * let us praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: 3:75 (Fit reverentia:)
Benedicámus Patrem et Fílium cum Sancto Spíritu: * laudémus et superexaltémus eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:56 Benedíctus es, Dómine, in firmaménto cæli: * et laudábilis, et gloriósus, et superexaltátus in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:56 Blessed art thou, O Lord, in the firmament of heaven: * and worthy of praise, and glorious for ever.

segments.t: Benedíctus es, Dómine, in firmaménto cæli: * et laudábilis, et gloriósus, et superexaltátus in sǽcula.

content.latin: Ant. Facta est cum Angelo multitúdo cæléstis exércitus laudántium Deum, et dicéntium: Glória in excélsis Deo, et in terra pax homínibus bonæ voluntátis, allelúia.
content.english: Ant. There was with the Angel a multitude of the heavenly host, praising God, and saying Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, to men of good will, alleluia.

segments.t: Ant.
Facta est cum Angelo multitúdo cæléstis exércitus laudántium Deum, et dicéntium: Glória in excélsis Deo, et in terra pax homínibus bonæ voluntátis, allelúia.

content.latin: Ant. Párvulus fílius * hódie natus est nobis: et vocábitur Deus, Fortis, allelúia, allelúia.
content.english: Ant. Unto us this day a little Child is born, * and His name shall be called the Mighty God, alleluia, alleluia.

segments.t: Ant.
Párvulus fílius * hódie natus est nobis: et vocábitur Deus, Fortis, allelúia, allelúia.

content.latin: Psalmus 148 [5]
content.english: Psalm 148 [5]

segments.t: Psalmus 148

content.latin: 148:1 Laudáte Dóminum de cælis: * laudáte eum in excélsis.
content.english: 148:1 Praise ye the Lord from the heavens * praise ye him in the high places.

segments.t: Laudáte Dóminum de cælis: * laudáte eum in excélsis.

content.latin: 148:2 Laudáte eum, omnes Ángeli eius: * laudáte eum, omnes virtútes eius.
content.english: 148:2 Praise ye him, all his angels: * praise ye him, all his hosts.

segments.t: Laudáte eum, omnes Ángeli eius: * laudáte eum, omnes virtútes eius.

content.latin: 148:3 Laudáte eum, sol et luna: * laudáte eum, omnes stellæ et lumen.
content.english: 148:3 Praise ye him, O sun and moon: * praise him, all ye stars and light.

segments.t: Laudáte eum, sol et luna: * laudáte eum, omnes stellæ et lumen.

content.latin: 148:4 Laudáte eum, cæli cælórum: * et aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, laudent nomen Dómini.
content.english: 148:4 Praise him, ye heavens of heavens: * and let all the waters that are above the heavens, praise the name of the Lord.

segments.t: Laudáte eum, cæli cælórum: * et aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, laudent nomen Dómini.

content.latin: 148:5 Quia ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.
content.english: 148:5 For he spoke, and they were made: * he commanded, and they were created.

segments.t: Quia ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.

content.latin: 148:6 Státuit ea in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi: * præcéptum pósuit, et non præteríbit.
content.english: 148:6 He hath established them for ever, and for ages of ages: * he hath made a decree, and it shall not pass away.

segments.t: Státuit ea in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi: * præcéptum pósuit, et non præteríbit.

content.latin: 148:7 Laudáte Dóminum de terra, * dracónes, et omnes abýssi.
content.english: 148:7 Praise the Lord from the earth, * ye dragons, and all ye deeps:

segments.t: Laudáte Dóminum de terra, * dracónes, et omnes abýssi.

content.latin: 148:8 Ignis, grando, nix, glácies, spíritus procellárum: * quæ fáciunt verbum eius:
content.english: 148:8 Fire, hail, snow, ice, stormy winds * which fulfill his word:

segments.t: Ignis, grando, nix, glácies, spíritus procellárum: * quæ fáciunt verbum eius:

content.latin: 148:9 Montes, et omnes colles: * ligna fructífera, et omnes cedri.
content.english: 148:9 Mountains and all hills, * fruitful trees and all cedars:

segments.t: Montes, et omnes colles: * ligna fructífera, et omnes cedri.

content.latin: 25:1 Iúdica me, Dómine, quóniam ego in innocéntia mea ingréssus sum: * et in Dómino sperans non infirmábor.
content.english: 25:1 Judge me, O Lord, for I have walked in my innocence: * and I have put my trust in the Lord, and shall not be weakened.

segments.t: Iúdica me, Dómine, quóniam ego in innocéntia mea ingréssus sum: * et in Dómino sperans non infirmábor.

content.latin: 25:2 Proba me, Dómine, et tenta me: * ure renes meos et cor meum.
content.english: 25:2 Prove me, O Lord, and try me; * burn my reins and my heart.

segments.t: Proba me, Dómine, et tenta me: * ure renes meos et cor meum.

content.latin: 25:3 Quóniam misericórdia tua ante óculos meos est: * et complácui in veritáte tua.
content.english: 25:3 For thy mercy is before my eyes; * and I am well pleased with thy truth.

segments.t: Quóniam misericórdia tua ante óculos meos est: * et complácui in veritáte tua.

content.latin: 25:4 Non sedi cum concílio vanitátis: * et cum iníqua geréntibus non introíbo.
content.english: 25:4 I have not sat with the council of vanity: * neither will I go in with the doers of unjust things.

segments.t: Non sedi cum concílio vanitátis: * et cum iníqua geréntibus non introíbo.

content.latin: 25:5 Odívi ecclésiam malignántium: * et cum ímpiis non sedébo.
content.english: 25:5 I have hated the assembly of the malignant; * and with the wicked I will not sit.

segments.t: Odívi ecclésiam malignántium: * et cum ímpiis non sedébo.

content.latin: 25:6 Lavábo inter innocéntes manus meas: * et circúmdabo altáre tuum, Dómine:
content.english: 25:6 I will wash my hands among the innocent; * and will compass thy altar, O Lord:

segments.t: Lavábo inter innocéntes manus meas: * et circúmdabo altáre tuum, Dómine:

content.latin: 25:7 Ut áudiam vocem laudis, * et enárrem univérsa mirabília tua.
content.english: 25:7 That I may hear the voice of thy praise: * and tell of all thy wondrous works.

segments.t: Ut áudiam vocem laudis, * et enárrem univérsa mirabília tua.

content.latin: 25:8 Dómine, diléxi decórem domus tuæ, * et locum habitatiónis glóriæ tuæ.
content.english: 25:8 I have loved, O Lord, the beauty of thy house; * and the place where thy glory dwelleth.

segments.t: Dómine, diléxi decórem domus tuæ, * et locum habitatiónis glóriæ tuæ.

content.latin: 25:9 Ne perdas cum ímpiis, Deus, ánimam meam, * et cum viris sánguinum vitam meam:
content.english: 25:9 Take not away my soul, O God, with the wicked: * nor my life with bloody men:

segments.t: Ne perdas cum ímpiis, Deus, ánimam meam, * et cum viris sánguinum vitam meam:

content.latin: 25:10 In quorum mánibus iniquitátes sunt: * déxtera eórum repléta est munéribus.

segments.t: In quorum mánibus iniquitátes sunt: * déxtera eórum repléta est munéribus.

content.latin: 25:11 Ego autem in innocéntia mea ingréssus sum: * rédime me, et miserére mei.
content.english: 25:11 But as for me, I have walked in my innocence: * redeem me, and have mercy on me.

segments.t: Ego autem in innocéntia mea ingréssus sum: * rédime me, et miserére mei.

segments.t: Psalmus 51

content.latin: 51:3 Quid gloriáris in malítia, * qui potens es in iniquitáte?
content.english: 51:3 Why dost thou glory in malice, * thou that art mighty in iniquity?

segments.t: Quid gloriáris in malítia, * qui potens es in iniquitáte?

content.latin: 51:4 Tota die iniustítiam cogitávit lingua tua: * sicut novácula acúta fecísti dolum.
content.english: 51:4 All the day long thy tongue hath devised injustice: * as a sharp razor, thou hast wrought deceit.

segments.t: Tota die iniustítiam cogitávit lingua tua: * sicut novácula acúta fecísti dolum.

content.latin: 51:5 Dilexísti malítiam super benignitátem: * iniquitátem magis quam loqui æquitátem.
content.english: 51:5 Thou hast loved malice more than goodness: * and iniquity rather than to speak righteousness.

segments.t: Dilexísti malítiam super benignitátem: * iniquitátem magis quam loqui æquitátem.

content.latin: 51:6 Dilexísti ómnia verba præcipitatiónis, * lingua dolósa.
content.english: 51:6 Thou hast loved all the words of ruin, * O deceitful tongue.

segments.t: Dilexísti ómnia verba præcipitatiónis, * lingua dolósa.

content.latin: Romæ natális sancti Silvéstri Primi, Papæ et Confessóris; qui Magnum Constantínum Imperatórem baptizávit, et Nicǽnam confirmávit Sýnodum, ac, multis áliis rebus sanctíssime gestis, quiévit in pace.
content.english: At Rome, holy Pope Silvester I who (was said by tradition to have) baptized the Emperor Constantine the Great, confirmed the decrees of the Council of Nicea, wrought many other holy works, and fell asleep in peace (in the year 335.)

content.latin: Item Romæ, via Salária, in cœmetério Priscíllæ, sanctárum Mártyrum Donátæ, Paulínæ, Rústicæ, Nominándæ, Serótinæ, Hiláriæ et Sociárum.
content.english: Likewise at Rome, at the cemetery of Priscilla upon the Salarian Way, the holy martyrs Donata, Paulina, Rustica, Nominanda, Serotina, Hilaria, and their companions.

content.latin: Apud Sénonas beatórum Sabiniáni Epíscopi, et Potentiáni; qui, a Pontífice Románo illuc ad prædicándum dirécti, confessiónis suæ martýrio eándem metrópolim illustrárunt.
content.english: At Sens, blessed Sabinian, (first) bishop of that see, and Potentian, who were sent thither to preach by the Roman Pontiff, and adorned that city by their last testimony. (He was the Apostle of Sens.)

content.latin: Cátanæ, in Sicília, pássio sanctórum Stéphani, Pontiáni, Attali, Fabiáni, Cornélii, Sexti, Floris, Quinctiáni, Minervíni et Simpliciáni.
content.english: There also in the persecution under the Emperor Aurelian the holy virgin and martyr Columba, who conquered fire and was slain with the sword (third century.)

content.latin: Apud Sénonas sanctæ Colúmbæ, Vírginis et Mártyris; quæ, igne superáto, in persecutióne Aureliáni Imperatóris, gládio cæsa est.
content.english: At Rhessara, the holy exorcist Hermes.

content.latin: Eódem die sancti Zótici, Presbýteri Románi; qui, Constantinópolim proféctus, illic alendórum orphanórum curam suscépit.
content.english: At Catania, in Sicily, the holy martyrs Stephen, Pontian, Attalus, Fabian, Cornelius, Sextus, Flos, Quintian, Minervinus and Simplician.

content.latin: Ravénnæ sancti Barbatiáni, Presbýteri et Confessóris.
content.english: On the same day holy Zoticus, a Roman priest, who went to Constantinople, and busied himself with the care of orphans.

content.latin: In pago Lalovésci, diœcésis Viennénsis, in Delphinátu, deposítio sancti Ioánnis-Francísci Regis, Sacerdótis e Societáte Iesu et Confessóris, exímiæ in salúte animárum procuránda caritátis et patiéntiæ viri; quem Clemens Papa Duodécimus in Sanctórum cánonem rétulit.
content.english: At Ravenna, the holy confessor the priest Barbatian.

content.latin: Rhætiáriæ sancti Hermétis Exorcístæ.
content.english: On the same day holy Melania, the younger, who left Rome along with her husband Pinian (son of the Prefect of Rome), and went to Jerusalem where she became a nun, and he a monk and both died holy deaths. (She was born in 383, married 410, and died in 439.)

content.latin: Lutétiæ Parisiórum sanctæ Catharínæ Labouré, Vírginis, e Societáte Puellárum Caritátis, quæ a Deípara Immaculáta singulári manifestatióne Sacri Numismátis donáta, virtútibus et miráculis insígnis éxstitit, et a Pio Papa Duodécimo in sanctárum Vírginum númerum reláta est.

content.english: Art with the Father and the Son,

content.latin: Dignáre promptus íngeri
content.english: It is the hour, our souls possess

content.english: With thy full flood of holiness.

content.english: Let flesh and heart and lips and mind

content.english: Sound forth our witness to mankind;

segments.t: Psalmus 53

content.latin: 53:3 Deus, in nómine tuo salvum me fac: * et in virtúte tua iúdica me.
content.english: 53:3 Save me, O God, by thy name, * and judge me in thy strength.

segments.t: Deus, in nómine tuo salvum me fac: * et in virtúte tua iúdica me.

content.latin: 53:4 Deus, exáudi oratiónem meam: * áuribus pércipe verba oris mei.
content.english: 53:4 O God, hear my prayer: * give ear to the words of my mouth.

segments.t: Deus, exáudi oratiónem meam: * áuribus pércipe verba oris mei.

content.latin: 53:5 Quóniam aliéni insurrexérunt advérsum me, et fortes quæsiérunt ánimam meam: * et non proposuérunt Deum ante conspéctum suum.
content.english: 53:5 For strangers have risen up against me; and the mighty have sought after my soul: * and they have not set God before their eyes.

segments.t: Quóniam aliéni insurrexérunt advérsum me, et fortes quæsiérunt ánimam meam: * et non proposuérunt Deum ante conspéctum suum.

content.latin: 53:6 Ecce enim, Deus ádiuvat me: * et Dóminus suscéptor est ánimæ meæ.
content.english: 53:6 For behold God is my helper: * and the Lord is the protector of my soul.

segments.t: Ecce enim, Deus ádiuvat me: * et Dóminus suscéptor est ánimæ meæ.

content.latin: 53:7 Avérte mala inimícis meis: * et in veritáte tua dispérde illos.
content.english: 53:7 Turn back the evils upon my enemies; * and cut them off in thy truth.

segments.t: Avérte mala inimícis meis: * et in veritáte tua dispérde illos.

content.latin: 53:8 Voluntárie sacrificábo tibi, * et confitébor nómini tuo, Dómine: quóniam bonum est:
content.english: 53:8 I will freely sacrifice to thee, * and will give praise, O God, to thy name: because it is good:

segments.t: Voluntárie sacrificábo tibi, * et confitébor nómini tuo, Dómine: quóniam bonum est:

content.latin: 53:9 Quóniam ex omni tribulatióne eripuísti me: * et super inimícos meos despéxit óculus meus.
content.english: 53:9 For thou hast delivered me out of all trouble: * and my eye hath looked down upon my enemies.

segments.t: Quóniam ex omni tribulatióne eripuísti me: * et super inimícos meos despéxit óculus meus.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Psalmus 54(2-16)

content.latin: 54:2 Exáudi, Deus, oratiónem meam, et ne despéxeris deprecatiónem meam: * inténde mihi, et exáudi me.
content.english: 54:2 Hear, O God, my prayer, and despise not my supplication: * be attentive to me and hear me.

segments.t: Exáudi, Deus, oratiónem meam, et ne despéxeris deprecatiónem meam: * inténde mihi, et exáudi me.

content.latin: 54:3 Contristátus sum in exercitatióne mea: * et conturbátus sum a voce inimíci, et a tribulatióne peccatóris.
content.english: 54:3 I am grieved in my exercise; * and am troubled, at the voice of the enemy, and at the tribulation of the sinner.

segments.t: Contristátus sum in exercitatióne mea: * et conturbátus sum a voce inimíci, et a tribulatióne peccatóris.

content.latin: 54:4 Quóniam declinavérunt in me iniquitátes: * et in ira molésti erant mihi.
content.english: 54:4 For they have cast iniquities upon me; * and in wrath they were troublesome to me.

segments.t: Quóniam declinavérunt in me iniquitátes: * et in ira molésti erant mihi.

content.latin: 54:5 Cor meum conturbátum est in me: * et formído mortis cécidit super me.
content.english: 54:5 My heart is troubled within me: * and the fear of death is fallen upon me.

segments.t: Cor meum conturbátum est in me: * et formído mortis cécidit super me.

content.latin: 54:6 Timor et tremor venérunt super me: * et contexérunt me ténebræ.
content.english: 54:6 Fear and trembling are come upon me: * and darkness hath covered me.

segments.t: Timor et tremor venérunt super me: * et contexérunt me ténebræ.

content.latin: 54:7 Et dixi: Quis dabit mihi pennas sicut colúmbæ, * et volábo, et requiéscam?
content.english: 54:7 And I said: Who will give me wings like a dove, * and I will fly and be at rest?

segments.t: Et dixi: Quis dabit mihi pennas sicut colúmbæ, * et volábo, et requiéscam?

content.latin: 54:8 Ecce, elongávi fúgiens: * et mansi in solitúdine.
content.english: 54:8 Lo, I have gone far off flying away; * and I abode in the wilderness.

segments.t: Ecce, elongávi fúgiens: * et mansi in solitúdine.

content.latin: 54:9 Exspectábam eum, qui salvum me fecit * a pusillanimitáte spíritus et tempestáte.
content.english: 54:9 I waited for him that hath saved me * from pusillanimity of spirit, and a storm.

segments.t: Exspectábam eum, qui salvum me fecit * a pusillanimitáte spíritus et tempestáte.

content.latin: 54:10 Præcípita, Dómine, dívide linguas eórum: * quóniam vidi iniquitátem, et contradictiónem in civitáte.
content.english: 54:10 Cast down, O Lord, and divide their tongues; * for I have seen iniquity and contradiction in the city.

segments.t: Præcípita, Dómine, dívide linguas eórum: * quóniam vidi iniquitátem, et contradictiónem in civitáte.

content.latin: 54:11 Die ac nocte circúmdabit eam super muros eius iníquitas: * et labor in médio eius, et iniustítia.
content.english: 54:11 Day and night shall iniquity surround it upon its walls: * and in the midst thereof are labour, and injustice.

segments.t: Die ac nocte circúmdabit eam super muros eius iníquitas: * et labor in médio eius, et iniustítia.

content.latin: 54:12 Et non defécit de platéis eius * usúra, et dolus.
content.english: 54:12 And usury and deceit * have not departed from its streets.

segments.t: Et non defécit de platéis eius * usúra, et dolus.

content.latin: 54:13 Quóniam si inimícus meus maledixísset mihi, * sustinuíssem útique.
content.english: 54:13 For if my enemy had reviled me, * I would verily have borne with it.

segments.t: Quóniam si inimícus meus maledixísset mihi, * sustinuíssem útique.

content.latin: 54:13 Et si is, qui óderat me, super me magna locútus fuísset, * abscondíssem me fórsitan ab eo.
content.english: 54:13 And if he that hated me had spoken great things against me, * I would perhaps have hidden myself from him.

segments.t: Et si is, qui óderat me, super me magna locútus fuísset, * abscondíssem me fórsitan ab eo.

content.latin: 54:14 Tu vero, homo unánimis: * dux meus, et notus meus:
content.english: 54:14 But thou a man of one mind, * my guide, and my familiar.

segments.t: Tu vero, homo unánimis: * dux meus, et notus meus:

content.latin: 54:15 Qui simul mecum dulces capiébas cibos: * in domo Dei ambulávimus cum consénsu.
content.english: 54:15 Who didst take sweetmeats together with me: * in the house of God we walked with consent.

segments.t: Qui simul mecum dulces capiébas cibos: * in domo Dei ambulávimus cum consénsu.

content.latin: 54:16 Véniat mors super illos: * et descéndant in inférnum vivéntes:
content.english: 54:16 Let death come upon them, * and let them go down alive into hell.

segments.t: Véniat mors super illos: * et descéndant in inférnum vivéntes:

content.latin: 54:16 Quóniam nequítiæ in habitáculis eórum: * in médio eórum.
content.english: 54:16 For there is wickedness in their dwellings: * in the midst of them.

segments.t: Quóniam nequítiæ in habitáculis eórum: * in médio eórum.

content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

Psalmus 54(17-24)

content.latin: 54:17 Ego autem ad Deum clamávi: * et Dóminus salvábit me.
content.english: 54:17 But I have cried to God: * and the Lord will save me.

segments.t: Ego autem ad Deum clamávi: * et Dóminus salvábit me.

content.latin: 54:18 Véspere, et mane, et merídie narrábo et annuntiábo: * et exáudiet vocem meam.
content.english: 54:18 Evening and morning, and at noon I will speak and declare: * and he shall hear my voice.

segments.t: Véspere, et mane, et merídie narrábo et annuntiábo: * et exáudiet vocem meam.

content.latin: 54:19 Rédimet in pace ánimam meam ab his, qui appropínquant mihi: * quóniam inter multos erant mecum.
content.english: 54:19 He shall redeem my soul in peace from them that draw near to me: * for among many they were with me.

segments.t: Rédimet in pace ánimam meam ab his, qui appropínquant mihi: * quóniam inter multos erant mecum.

content.latin: 54:20 Exáudiet Deus, et humiliábit illos, * qui est ante sǽcula.
content.english: 54:20 God shall hear, * and the Eternal shall humble them.

segments.t: Exáudiet Deus, et humiliábit illos, * qui est ante sǽcula.

content.latin: 54:20 Non enim est illis commutátio, et non timuérunt Deum: * exténdit manum suam in retribuéndo.
content.english: 54:20 For there is no change with them, and they have not feared God: * he hath stretched forth his hand to repay.

segments.t: Non enim est illis commutátio, et non timuérunt Deum: * exténdit manum suam in retribuéndo.

content.latin: 54:21 Contaminavérunt testaméntum eius, divísi sunt ab ira vultus eius: * et appropinquávit cor illíus.
content.english: 54:21 They have defiled his covenant, they are divided by the wrath of his countenance, * and his heart hath drawn near.

segments.t: Contaminavérunt testaméntum eius, divísi sunt ab ira vultus eius: * et appropinquávit cor illíus.

content.latin: 54:22 Mollíti sunt sermónes eius super óleum: * et ipsi sunt iácula.
content.english: 54:22 His words are smoother than oil, * and the same are darts.

segments.t: Mollíti sunt sermónes eius super óleum: * et ipsi sunt iácula.

content.latin: 54:23 Iacta super Dóminum curam tuam, et ipse te enútriet: * non dabit in ætérnum fluctuatiónem iusto.
content.english: 54:23 Cast thy care upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee: * he shall not suffer the just to waver for ever.

segments.t: Iacta super Dóminum curam tuam, et ipse te enútriet: * non dabit in ætérnum fluctuatiónem iusto.

content.latin: 54:24 Tu vero, Deus, dedúces eos, * in púteum intéritus.
content.english: 54:24 But thou, O God, shalt bring them down * into the pit of destruction.

segments.t: Tu vero, Deus, dedúces eos, * in púteum intéritus.

content.latin: 54:24 Viri sánguinum, et dolósi non dimidiábunt dies suos: * ego autem sperábo in te, Dómine.
content.english: 54:24 Bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; * but I will trust in thee, O Lord.

segments.t: Viri sánguinum, et dolósi non dimidiábunt dies suos: * ego autem sperábo in te, Dómine.

content.english: Ant. For behold God is my helper: and the Lord is the protector of my soul.

Deus ádiuvat me: et Dóminus suscéptor est ánimæ meæ.

content.latin: Multifáriam, multísque modis olim Deus loquens pátribus in prophétis: novíssime diébus istis locútus est nobis in Fílio, quem constítuit herédem universórum, per quem fecit et sǽcula.
content.english: God, who, at sundry times and in diverse manners, spoke in times past to the fathers by the prophets, last of all, in these days hath spoken to us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the world.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℟.br. Verbum caro factum est, * Allelúia, allelúia.
content.english: ℟.br. The Word was made flesh. * Alleluia, Alleluia.

segments.t: ℟.br.
Verbum caro factum est, * Allelúia, allelúia.

content.english: ℟. The Word was made flesh. * Alleluia, Alleluia.

segments.t: Verbum caro factum est, * Allelúia, allelúia.

content.english: ℣. And dwelt among us.

content.english: ℟. The Word was made flesh. * Alleluia, Alleluia.

segments.t: Verbum caro factum est, * Allelúia, allelúia.

content.latin: ℣. Ipse invocábit me, allelúia.
content.english: ℣. He shall cry unto Me, alleluia.

segments.t: Ipse invocábit me, allelúia.

content.latin: ℟. Pater meus es tu, allelúia.
content.english: ℟. Thou art My Father, alleluia.

segments.t: Pater meus es tu, allelúia.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Concéde, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut nos Unigéniti tui nova per carnem Natívitas líberet; quos sub peccáti iugo vetústa sérvitus tenet.
content.english: Grant, we beseech thee, almighty God, that the new birth of thy Only-begotten Son as man may set us free, who are held by the old bondage under the yoke of sin.

content.latin: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through the same Jesus Christ, thy Son, Our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: ℣. Benedicámus Dómino.
content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedicámus Dómino.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.
content.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

segments.t: Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.
content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.latin: Allelúia.
content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Rector potens, verax Deus,
content.english: O God of truth, O Lord of might,

content.latin: Qui témperas rerum vices,
content.english: Who orderest time and change aright,

content.latin: Splendóre mane illúminas,
content.english: Who send’st the early morning ray,

content.latin: Et ígnibus merídiem:
content.english: And light’st the glow of perfect day:

content.latin: Exstíngue flammas lítium,
content.english: Extinguish thou each sinful fire,

content.latin: Aufer calórem nóxium,
content.english: And banish every ill desire;

content.latin: Confer salútem córporum,
content.english: And while thou keep’st the body whole,

content.latin: Verámque pacem córdium.
content.english: Shed forth thy peace upon the soul.

content.latin: Præsta, Pater piíssime,
content.english: Almighty Father, hear our cry,

content.latin: Patríque compar Únice,
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, our Lord most High,

content.latin: Cum Spíritu Paráclito
content.english: Who, with the Holy Ghost and thee,

content.latin: Regnans per omne sǽculum.
content.english: Doth live and reign eternally.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: Ant. In Deo sperávi * non timébo quid fáciat mihi homo.
content.english: Ant. In God I have put my trust * I will not fear what flesh can do against me.

segments.t: Ant.
In Deo sperávi * non timébo quid fáciat mihi homo.

content.latin: Psalmus 55 [1]
content.english: Psalm 55 [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 55

content.latin: 55:2 Miserére mei, Deus, quóniam conculcávit me homo: * tota die impúgnans tribulávit me.
content.english: 55:2 Have mercy on me, O God, for man hath trodden me under foot; * all the day long he hath afflicted me fighting against me.

segments.t: Miserére mei, Deus, quóniam conculcávit me homo: * tota die impúgnans tribulávit me.

content.latin: 55:3 Conculcavérunt me inimíci mei tota die: * quóniam multi bellántes advérsum me.
content.english: 55:3 My enemies have trodden on me all the day long; * for they are many that make war against me.

segments.t: Conculcavérunt me inimíci mei tota die: * quóniam multi bellántes advérsum me.

content.latin: 55:4 Ab altitúdine diéi timébo: * ego vero in te sperábo.
content.english: 55:4 From the height of the day I shall fear: * but I will trust in thee.

segments.t: Ab altitúdine diéi timébo: * ego vero in te sperábo.

content.latin: 55:5 In Deo laudábo sermónes meos, in Deo sperávi: * non timébo quid fáciat mihi caro.
content.english: 55:5 In God I will praise my words, in God I have put my trust: * I will not fear what flesh can do against me.

segments.t: In Deo laudábo sermónes meos, in Deo sperávi: * non timébo quid fáciat mihi caro.

content.latin: 55:6 Tota die verba mea exsecrabántur: * advérsum me omnes cogitatiónes eórum in malum.
content.english: 55:6 All the day long they detested my words: * all their thoughts were against me unto evil.

segments.t: Tota die verba mea exsecrabántur: * advérsum me omnes cogitatiónes eórum in malum.

content.latin: 55:7 Inhabitábunt et abscóndent: * ipsi calcáneum meum observábunt.
content.english: 55:7 They will dwell and hide themselves: * they will watch my heel.

segments.t: Inhabitábunt et abscóndent: * ipsi calcáneum meum observábunt.

content.latin: 55:8 Sicut sustinuérunt ánimam meam, pro níhilo salvos fácies illos: * in ira pópulos confrínges.
content.english: 55:8 As they have waited for my soul, for nothing shalt thou save them: * in thy anger thou shalt break the people in pieces.

segments.t: Sicut sustinuérunt ánimam meam, pro níhilo salvos fácies illos: * in ira pópulos confrínges.

content.latin: 55:9 Deus, vitam meam annuntiávi tibi: * posuísti lácrimas meas in conspéctu tuo.
content.english: 55:9 O God, I have declared to thee my life: * thou hast set my tears in thy sight,

segments.t: Deus, vitam meam annuntiávi tibi: * posuísti lácrimas meas in conspéctu tuo.

content.latin: 55:9 Sicut et in promissióne tua: * tunc converténtur inimíci mei retrórsum:
content.english: 55:9 As also in thy promise. * Then shall my enemies be turned back.

segments.t: Sicut et in promissióne tua: * tunc converténtur inimíci mei retrórsum:

content.latin: 55:10 In quacúmque die invocávero te: * ecce, cognóvi, quóniam Deus meus es.
content.english: 55:10 In what day soever I shall call upon thee, * behold I know thou art my God.

segments.t: In quacúmque die invocávero te: * ecce, cognóvi, quóniam Deus meus es.

content.latin: 55:11 In Deo laudábo verbum, in Dómino laudábo sermónem: * in Deo sperávi, non timébo quid fáciat mihi homo.
content.english: 55:11 In God will I praise the word, in the Lord will I praise his speech. * In God have I hoped, I will not fear what man can do to me.

segments.t: In Deo laudábo verbum, in Dómino laudábo sermónem: * in Deo sperávi, non timébo quid fáciat mihi homo.

content.latin: 55:12 In me sunt, Deus, vota tua, * quæ reddam, laudatiónes tibi.
content.english: 55:12 In me, O God, are vows to thee, * which I will pay, praises to thee:

segments.t: In me sunt, Deus, vota tua, * quæ reddam, laudatiónes tibi.

content.latin: 55:13 Quóniam eripuísti ánimam meam de morte, et pedes meos de lapsu: * ut pláceam coram Deo in lúmine vivéntium.
content.english: 55:13 Because thou hast delivered my soul from death, my feet from falling: * that I may please in the sight of God, in the light of the living.

segments.t: Quóniam eripuísti ánimam meam de morte, et pedes meos de lapsu: * ut pláceam coram Deo in lúmine vivéntium.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Psalmus 56 [2]
content.english: Psalm 56 [2]

segments.t: Psalmus 56

content.latin: 56:2 Miserére mei, Deus, miserére mei: * quóniam in te confídit ánima mea.
content.english: 56:2 Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me: * for my soul trusteth in thee.

segments.t: Miserére mei, Deus, miserére mei: * quóniam in te confídit ánima mea.

content.latin: 56:2 Et in umbra alárum tuárum sperábo, * donec tránseat iníquitas.
content.english: 56:2 And in the shadow of thy wings will I hope, * until iniquity pass away.

segments.t: Et in umbra alárum tuárum sperábo, * donec tránseat iníquitas.

content.latin: 56:3 Clamábo ad Deum altíssimum: * Deum qui benefécit mihi.
content.english: 56:3 I will cry to God the most High; * to God who hath done good to me.

segments.t: Clamábo ad Deum altíssimum: * Deum qui benefécit mihi.

content.latin: 56:4 Misit de cælo, et liberávit me: * dedit in oppróbrium conculcántes me.
content.english: 56:4 He hath sent from heaven and delivered me: * he hath made them a reproach that trod upon me.

segments.t: Misit de cælo, et liberávit me: * dedit in oppróbrium conculcántes me.

content.latin: 56:4 Misit Deus misericórdiam suam, et veritátem suam, * et erípuit ánimam meam de médio catulórum leónum: dormívi conturbátus.
content.english: 56:4 God hath sent his mercy and his truth, * and he hath delivered my soul from the midst of the young lions. I slept troubled.

segments.t: Misit Deus misericórdiam suam, et veritátem suam, * et erípuit ánimam meam de médio catulórum leónum: dormívi conturbátus.

content.latin: 56:5 Fílii hóminum dentes eórum arma et sagíttæ: * et lingua eórum gládius acútus.
content.english: 56:5 The sons of men, whose teeth are weapons and arrows, * and their tongue a sharp sword.

segments.t: Fílii hóminum dentes eórum arma et sagíttæ: * et lingua eórum gládius acútus.

content.latin: 56:6 Exaltáre super cælos, Deus, * et in omnem terram glória tua.
content.english: 56:6 Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens, * and thy glory above all the earth.

segments.t: Exaltáre super cælos, Deus, * et in omnem terram glória tua.

content.latin: 56:7 Láqueum paravérunt pédibus meis: * et incurvavérunt ánimam meam.
content.english: 56:7 They prepared a snare for my feet; * and they bowed down my soul.

segments.t: Láqueum paravérunt pédibus meis: * et incurvavérunt ánimam meam.

content.latin: 56:7 Fodérunt ante fáciem meam fóveam: * et incidérunt in eam.
content.english: 56:7 They dug a pit before my face, * and they are fallen into it.

segments.t: Fodérunt ante fáciem meam fóveam: * et incidérunt in eam.

content.latin: 56:8 Parátum cor meum, Deus, parátum cor meum: * cantábo, et psalmum dicam.
content.english: 56:8 My heart is ready, O God, my heart is ready: * I will sing, and rehearse a psalm.

segments.t: Parátum cor meum, Deus, parátum cor meum: * cantábo, et psalmum dicam.

content.latin: 56:9 Exsúrge, glória mea, exsúrge, psaltérium et cíthara: * exsúrgam dilúculo.
content.english: 56:9 Arise, O my glory, arise psaltery and harp: * I will arise early.

segments.t: Exsúrge, glória mea, exsúrge, psaltérium et cíthara: * exsúrgam dilúculo.

content.latin: 56:10 Confitébor tibi in pópulis, Dómine: * et psalmum dicam tibi in géntibus:
content.english: 56:10 I will give praise to thee, O Lord, among the people: * I will sing a psalm to thee among the nations.

segments.t: Confitébor tibi in pópulis, Dómine: * et psalmum dicam tibi in géntibus:

content.latin: 56:11 Quóniam magnificáta est usque ad cælos misericórdia tua, * et usque ad nubes véritas tua.
content.english: 56:11 For thy mercy is magnified even to the heavens: * and thy truth unto the clouds.

segments.t: Quóniam magnificáta est usque ad cælos misericórdia tua, * et usque ad nubes véritas tua.

content.latin: 56:12 Exaltáre super cælos, Deus: * et super omnem terram glória tua.
content.english: 56:12 Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: * and thy glory above all the earth.

segments.t: Exaltáre super cælos, Deus: * et super omnem terram glória tua.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Psalmus 57 [3]
content.english: Psalm 57 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 57

content.latin: 57:2 Si vere útique iustítiam loquímini: * recta iudicáte, fílii hóminum.
content.english: 57:2 If in very deed you speak justice: * judge right things, ye sons of men.

segments.t: Si vere útique iustítiam loquímini: * recta iudicáte, fílii hóminum.

content.latin: 57:3 Étenim in corde iniquitátes operámini: * in terra iniustítias manus vestræ concínnant.
content.english: 57:3 For in your heart you work iniquity: * your hands forge injustice in the earth.

segments.t: Étenim in corde iniquitátes operámini: * in terra iniustítias manus vestræ concínnant.

content.latin: 57:4 Alienáti sunt peccatóres a vulva, erravérunt ab útero: * locúti sunt falsa.
content.english: 57:4 The wicked are alienated from the womb; they have gone astray from the womb: * they have spoken false things.

segments.t: Alienáti sunt peccatóres a vulva, erravérunt ab útero: * locúti sunt falsa.

content.latin: 57:5 Furor illis secúndum similitúdinem serpéntis: * sicut áspidis surdæ, et obturántis aures suas,
content.english: 57:5 Their madness is according to the likeness of a serpent: * like the deaf asp that stoppeth her ears:

segments.t: Furor illis secúndum similitúdinem serpéntis: * sicut áspidis surdæ, et obturántis aures suas,

content.latin: 57:6 Quæ non exáudiet vocem incantántium: * et venéfici incantántis sapiénter.
content.english: 57:6 Which will not hear the voice of the charmers; * nor of the wizard that charmeth wisely.

segments.t: Quæ non exáudiet vocem incantántium: * et venéfici incantántis sapiénter.

content.latin: 57:7 Deus cónteret dentes eórum in ore ipsórum: * molas leónum confrínget Dóminus.
content.english: 57:7 God shall break in pieces their teeth in their mouth: * the Lord shall break the grinders of the lions.

segments.t: Deus cónteret dentes eórum in ore ipsórum: * molas leónum confrínget Dóminus.

content.latin: 57:8 Ad níhilum devénient tamquam aqua decúrrens: * inténdit arcum suum donec infirméntur.
content.english: 57:8 They shall come to nothing, like water running down; * he hath bent his bow till they be weakened.

segments.t: Ad níhilum devénient tamquam aqua decúrrens: * inténdit arcum suum donec infirméntur.

content.latin: 57:9 Sicut cera, quæ fluit, auferéntur: * supercécidit ignis, et non vidérunt solem.
content.english: 57:9 Like wax that melteth they shall be taken away: * fire hath fallen on them, and they shall not see the sun.

segments.t: Sicut cera, quæ fluit, auferéntur: * supercécidit ignis, et non vidérunt solem.

content.latin: 57:10 Priúsquam intellégerent spinæ vestræ rhamnum: * sicut vivéntes, sic in ira absórbet eos.
content.english: 57:10 Before your thorns could know the brier; he swalloweth them up, * as alive, in his wrath.

segments.t: Priúsquam intellégerent spinæ vestræ rhamnum: * sicut vivéntes, sic in ira absórbet eos.

content.latin: 57:11 Lætábitur iustus cum víderit vindíctam: * manus suas lavábit in sánguine peccatóris.
content.english: 57:11 The just shall rejoice when he shall see the revenge: * he shall wash his hands in the blood of the sinner.

segments.t: Lætábitur iustus cum víderit vindíctam: * manus suas lavábit in sánguine peccatóris.

content.latin: 57:12 Et dicet homo: Si útique est fructus iusto: * útique est Deus iúdicans eos in terra.
content.english: 57:12 And man shall say: If indeed there be fruit to the just: * there is indeed a God that judgeth them on the earth.

segments.t: Et dicet homo: Si útique est fructus iusto: * útique est Deus iúdicans eos in terra.

content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.english: Ant. In God I have put my trust I will not fear what flesh can do against me.

content.english: Heb 1:10

content.english: And: Thou in the beginning, O Lord, didst found the earth: and the works of thy hands are the heavens.

content.english: ℟. The salvation of our God. Alleluia.

content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Concéde, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut nos Unigéniti tui nova per carnem Natívitas líberet; quos sub peccáti iugo vetústa sérvitus tenet.
content.english: Grant, we beseech thee, almighty God, that the new birth of thy Only-begotten Son as man may set us free, who are held by the old bondage under the yoke of sin.

content.latin: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through the same Jesus Christ, thy Son, Our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

content.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

segments.t: Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.

content.english: ℟. Amen.

content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.latin: Allelúia.
content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Rerum, Deus, tenax vigor,
content.english: O strength and stay upholding all creation,

content.latin: Immótus in te pérmanens,
content.english: Who ever dost thyself unmoved abide,

content.latin: Lucis diúrnæ témpora
content.english: Yet day by day the light in due gradation

content.latin: Succéssibus detérminans:
content.english: From hour to hour through all its changes guide:

content.latin: Largíre lumen véspere,
content.english: Grant to life’s day a calm unclouded ending,

content.latin: Quo vita nusquam décidat,
content.english: An eve untouched by shadows of decay,

content.latin: Sed prǽmium mortis sacræ
content.english: The brightness of a holy death-bed blending

content.latin: Perénnis instet glória.
content.english: With dawning glories of th’ eternal day.

content.latin: Præsta, Pater piíssime,
content.english: Hear us, O Father, gracious and forgiving,

content.latin: Patríque compar Únice,
content.english: And thou, O Christ, the co-eternal Word,

content.latin: Cum Spíritu Paráclito
content.english: Who, with the Holy Ghost, by all things living

content.latin: Regnans per omne sǽculum.
content.english: Now and to endless ages art adored.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Deus meus * misericórdia tua prævéniet me.
content.english: Ant. My God, * his mercy shall prevent me.

segments.t: Ant.
Deus meus * misericórdia tua prævéniet me.
Psalmus 58(2-11)

content.latin: 58:2 Éripe me de inimícis meis, Deus meus: * et ab insurgéntibus in me líbera me.
content.english: 58:2 Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; * and defend me from them that rise up against me.

segments.t: Éripe me de inimícis meis, Deus meus: * et ab insurgéntibus in me líbera me.

content.latin: 58:3 Éripe me de operántibus iniquitátem: * et de viris sánguinum salva me.
content.english: 58:3 Deliver me from them that work iniquity, * and save me from bloody men.

segments.t: Éripe me de operántibus iniquitátem: * et de viris sánguinum salva me.

content.latin: 58:4 Quia ecce cepérunt ánimam meam: * irruérunt in me fortes.
content.english: 58:4 For behold they have caught my soul: * the mighty have rushed in upon me:

segments.t: Quia ecce cepérunt ánimam meam: * irruérunt in me fortes.

content.latin: 58:5 Neque iníquitas mea, neque peccátum meum, Dómine: * sine iniquitáte cucúrri, et diréxi.
content.english: 58:5 Neither is it my iniquity, nor my sin, O Lord: * without iniquity have I run, and directed my steps.

segments.t: Neque iníquitas mea, neque peccátum meum, Dómine: * sine iniquitáte cucúrri, et diréxi.

content.latin: 58:6 Exsúrge in occúrsum meum, et vide: * et tu, Dómine, Deus virtútum, Deus Israël,
content.english: 58:6 Rise up thou to meet me, and behold: * even thou, O Lord, the God of hosts, the God of Israel.

segments.t: Exsúrge in occúrsum meum, et vide: * et tu, Dómine, Deus virtútum, Deus Israël,

content.latin: 58:6 Inténde ad visitándas omnes gentes: * non misereáris ómnibus, qui operántur iniquitátem.
content.english: 58:6 Attend to visit all the nations: * have no mercy on all them that work iniquity.

segments.t: Inténde ad visitándas omnes gentes: * non misereáris ómnibus, qui operántur iniquitátem.

content.latin: 58:7 Converténtur ad vésperam: et famem patiéntur ut canes, * et circuíbunt civitátem.
content.english: 58:7 They shall return at evening, and shall suffer hunger like dogs: * and shall go round about the city.

segments.t: Converténtur ad vésperam: et famem patiéntur ut canes, * et circuíbunt civitátem.

content.latin: 58:8 Ecce, loquéntur in ore suo, et gládius in lábiis eórum: * quóniam quis audívit?
content.english: 58:8 Behold they shall speak with their mouth, and a sword is in their lips: * for who, say they, hath heard us?

segments.t: Ecce, loquéntur in ore suo, et gládius in lábiis eórum: * quóniam quis audívit?

content.latin: 58:9 Et tu, Dómine, deridébis eos: * ad níhilum dedúces omnes gentes.
content.english: 58:9 But thou, O Lord, shalt laugh at them: * thou shalt bring all the nations to nothing.

segments.t: Et tu, Dómine, deridébis eos: * ad níhilum dedúces omnes gentes.

content.latin: 58:10 Fortitúdinem meam ad te custódiam, quia, Deus, suscéptor meus es: * Deus meus, misericórdia eius prævéniet me.
content.english: 58:10 I will keep my strength to thee: for thou art my protector: * my God, his mercy shall prevent me.

segments.t: Fortitúdinem meam ad te custódiam, quia, Deus, suscéptor meus es: * Deus meus, misericórdia eius prævéniet me.

content.latin: 58:12 Deus osténdet mihi super inimícos meos, ne occídas eos: * nequándo obliviscántur pópuli mei.
content.english: 58:12 God shall let me see over my enemies: slay them not, * lest at any time my people forget.

segments.t: Deus osténdet mihi super inimícos meos, ne occídas eos: * nequándo obliviscántur pópuli mei.

content.latin: 58:12 Dispérge illos in virtúte tua: * et depóne eos, protéctor meus, Dómine:
content.english: 58:12 And scatter them by thy power; * and bring them down, O Lord, my protector:

segments.t: Dispérge illos in virtúte tua: * et depóne eos, protéctor meus, Dómine:

content.latin: 58:13 Delíctum oris eórum, sermónem labiórum ipsórum: * et comprehendántur in supérbia sua.
content.english: 58:13 For the sin of their mouth, and the word of their lips: * and let them be taken in their pride.

segments.t: Delíctum oris eórum, sermónem labiórum ipsórum: * et comprehendántur in supérbia sua.

content.latin: 58:13 Et de exsecratióne et mendácio annuntiabúntur in consummatióne: * in ira consummatiónis, et non erunt.
content.english: 58:13 And for their cursing and lying they shall be talked of, when they are consumed: * when they are consumed by thy wrath, and they shall be no more.

segments.t: Et de exsecratióne et mendácio annuntiabúntur in consummatióne: * in ira consummatiónis, et non erunt.

content.latin: 58:14 Et scient quia Deus dominábitur Iacob: * et fínium terræ.
content.english: 58:14 And they shall know that God will rule Jacob, * and all the ends of the earth.

segments.t: Et scient quia Deus dominábitur Iacob: * et fínium terræ.

content.latin: 58:15 Converténtur ad vésperam: et famem patiéntur ut canes, * et circuíbunt civitátem.
content.english: 58:15 They shall return at evening and shall suffer hunger like dogs: * and shall go round about the city.

segments.t: Converténtur ad vésperam: et famem patiéntur ut canes, * et circuíbunt civitátem.

content.latin: 58:16 Ipsi dispergéntur ad manducándum: * si vero non fúerint saturáti, et murmurábunt.
content.english: 58:16 They shall be scattered abroad to eat, * and shall murmur if they be not filled.

segments.t: Ipsi dispergéntur ad manducándum: * si vero non fúerint saturáti, et murmurábunt.

content.latin: 58:17 Ego autem cantábo fortitúdinem tuam: * et exsultábo mane misericórdiam tuam.
content.english: 58:17 But I will sing thy strength: * and will extol thy mercy in the morning.

segments.t: Ego autem cantábo fortitúdinem tuam: * et exsultábo mane misericórdiam tuam.

content.latin: 58:17 Quia factus es suscéptor meus, * et refúgium meum, in die tribulatiónis meæ.
content.english: 58:17 For thou art become my support, * and my refuge, in the day of my trouble.

segments.t: Quia factus es suscéptor meus, * et refúgium meum, in die tribulatiónis meæ.

content.latin: 58:18 Adiútor meus, tibi psallam, quia, Deus, suscéptor meus es: * Deus meus, misericórdia mea.
content.english: 58:18 Unto thee, O my helper, will I sing, for thou art God my defence: * my God my mercy.

segments.t: Adiútor meus, tibi psallam, quia, Deus, suscéptor meus es: * Deus meus, misericórdia mea.

content.english: Psalm 59 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 59

content.latin: 59:3 Deus, repulísti nos, et destruxísti nos: * irátus es, et misértus es nobis.
content.english: 59:3 God, thou hast cast us off, and hast destroyed us; * thou hast been angry, and hast had mercy on us.

segments.t: Deus, repulísti nos, et destruxísti nos: * irátus es, et misértus es nobis.

content.latin: 59:4 Commovísti terram, et conturbásti eam: * sana contritiónes eius, quia commóta est.
content.english: 59:4 Thou hast moved the earth, and hast troubled it: * heal thou the breaches thereof, for it has been moved.

segments.t: Commovísti terram, et conturbásti eam: * sana contritiónes eius, quia commóta est.

content.latin: 59:5 Ostendísti pópulo tuo dura: * potásti nos vino compunctiónis.
content.english: 59:5 Thou hast shewn thy people hard things; * thou hast made us drink the wine of sorrow.

segments.t: Ostendísti pópulo tuo dura: * potásti nos vino compunctiónis.

content.latin: 59:6 Dedísti metuéntibus te significatiónem: * ut fúgiant a fácie arcus:
content.english: 59:6 Thou hast given a warning to them that fear thee: * that they may flee from before the bow:

segments.t: Dedísti metuéntibus te significatiónem: * ut fúgiant a fácie arcus:

content.latin: 59:7 Ut liberéntur dilécti tui: * salvum fac déxtera tua, et exáudi me.
content.english: 59:7 That thy beloved may be delivered. * Save me with thy right hand, and hear me.

segments.t: Ut liberéntur dilécti tui: * salvum fac déxtera tua, et exáudi me.

content.latin: 59:8 Deus locútus est in sancto suo: * lætábor, et partíbor Síchimam: et convállem tabernaculórum metíbor.
content.english: 59:8 God hath spoken in his holy place: * I will rejoice, and I will divide Sichem; and will mete out the vale of tabernacles.

segments.t: Deus locútus est in sancto suo: * lætábor, et partíbor Síchimam: et convállem tabernaculórum metíbor.

content.latin: 59:9 Meus est Gálaad, et meus est Manásses: * et Éphraim fortitúdo cápitis mei.
content.english: 59:9 Galaad is mine, and Manasses is mine: * and Ephraim is the strength of my head.

segments.t: Meus est Gálaad, et meus est Manásses: * et Éphraim fortitúdo cápitis mei.

content.latin: 59:9 Iuda rex meus: * Moab olla spei meæ.
content.english: 59:9 Juda is my king: * Moab is the pot of my hope.

segments.t: Iuda rex meus: * Moab olla spei meæ.

content.latin: 59:10 In Idumǽam exténdam calceaméntum meum: * mihi alienígenæ súbditi sunt.
content.english: 59:10 Into Edom will I stretch out my shoe: * to me the foreigners are made subject.

segments.t: In Idumǽam exténdam calceaméntum meum: * mihi alienígenæ súbditi sunt.

content.latin: 59:11 Quis dedúcet me in civitátem munítam? * quis dedúcet me usque in Idumǽam?
content.english: 59:11 Who will bring me into the strong city? * who will lead me into Edom?

segments.t: Quis dedúcet me in civitátem munítam? * quis dedúcet me usque in Idumǽam?

content.latin: 59:12 Nonne tu, Deus, qui repulísti nos? * et non egrediéris, Deus, in virtútibus nostris?
content.english: 59:12 Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? * and wilt not thou, O God, go out with our armies?

segments.t: Nonne tu, Deus, qui repulísti nos? * et non egrediéris, Deus, in virtútibus nostris?

content.latin: 59:13 Da nobis auxílium de tribulatióne: * quia vana salus hóminis.
content.english: 59:13 Give us help from trouble: * for vain is the salvation of man.

segments.t: Da nobis auxílium de tribulatióne: * quia vana salus hóminis.

content.latin: 59:14 In Deo faciémus virtútem: * et ipse ad níhilum dedúcet tribulántes nos.
content.english: 59:14 Through God we shall do mightily: * and he shall bring to nothing them that afflict us.

segments.t: In Deo faciémus virtútem: * et ipse ad níhilum dedúcet tribulántes nos.

content.english: Ant. My God, his mercy shall prevent me.

content.latin: Ipsi períbunt, tu autem permanébis; et omnes sicut vestiméntum veteráscent: et velut amíctum mutábis eos, et mutabúntur: tu autem idem ipse es, et anni tui non defícient.
content.english: They shall perish, but thou shalt continue: and they shall all grow old as a garment. And as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed: but thou art the selfsame, and thy years shall not fail.

content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Concéde, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut nos Unigéniti tui nova per carnem Natívitas líberet; quos sub peccáti iugo vetústa sérvitus tenet.
content.english: Grant, we beseech thee, almighty God, that the new birth of thy Only-begotten Son as man may set us free, who are held by the old bondage under the yoke of sin.

content.latin: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through the same Jesus Christ, thy Son, Our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

content.english: Psalm 109 [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 109

content.latin: 109:1 Dixit Dóminus Dómino meo: * Sede a dextris meis:
content.english: 109:1 The Lord said to my Lord: * Sit thou at my right hand:

segments.t: Dixit Dóminus Dómino meo: * Sede a dextris meis:

content.latin: 109:1 Donec ponam inimícos tuos, * scabéllum pedum tuórum.
content.english: 109:1 Until I make thy enemies * thy footstool.

segments.t: Donec ponam inimícos tuos, * scabéllum pedum tuórum.

content.latin: 109:2 Virgam virtútis tuæ emíttet Dóminus ex Sion: * domináre in médio inimicórum tuórum.
content.english: 109:2 The Lord will send forth the sceptre of thy power out of Sion: * rule thou in the midst of thy enemies.

segments.t: Virgam virtútis tuæ emíttet Dóminus ex Sion: * domináre in médio inimicórum tuórum.

content.latin: 109:3 Tecum princípium in die virtútis tuæ in splendóribus sanctórum: * ex útero ante lucíferum génui te.
content.english: 109:3 With thee is the principality in the day of thy strength: in the brightness of the saints: * from the womb before the day star I begot thee.

segments.t: Tecum princípium in die virtútis tuæ in splendóribus sanctórum: * ex útero ante lucíferum génui te.

content.latin: 109:4 Iurávit Dóminus, et non pœnitébit eum: * Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.
content.english: 109:4 The Lord hath sworn, and he will not repent: * Thou art a priest for ever according to the order of Melchisedech.

segments.t: Iurávit Dóminus, et non pœnitébit eum: * Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.

content.latin: 109:5 Dóminus a dextris tuis, * confrégit in die iræ suæ reges.
content.english: 109:5 The Lord at thy right hand * hath broken kings in the day of his wrath.

segments.t: Dóminus a dextris tuis, * confrégit in die iræ suæ reges.

content.latin: 109:6 Iudicábit in natiónibus, implébit ruínas: * conquassábit cápita in terra multórum.
content.english: 109:6 He shall judge among nations, he shall fill ruins: * he shall crush the heads in the land of many.

segments.t: Iudicábit in natiónibus, implébit ruínas: * conquassábit cápita in terra multórum.

content.latin: 109:7 De torrénte in via bibet: * proptérea exaltábit caput.
content.english: 109:7 He shall drink of the torrent in the way: * therefore shall he lift up the head.

segments.t: De torrénte in via bibet: * proptérea exaltábit caput.

content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.english: Ant. The Lord sent redemption * unto His people, He hath commanded His covenant for ever.

segments.t: Ant.
Redemptiónem * misit Dóminus pópulo suo: mandávit in ætérnum testaméntum suum.

content.latin: Psalmus 110 [2]
content.english: Psalm 110 [2]

segments.t: Psalmus 110

content.latin: 110:1 Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo: * in consílio iustórum, et congregatióne.
content.english: 110:1 I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; * in the council of the just, and in the congregation.

segments.t: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo: * in consílio iustórum, et congregatióne.

content.latin: 110:2 Magna ópera Dómini: * exquisíta in omnes voluntátes eius.
content.english: 110:2 Great are the works of the Lord: * sought out according to all his wills.

segments.t: Magna ópera Dómini: * exquisíta in omnes voluntátes eius.

content.latin: 110:3 Conféssio et magnificéntia opus eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
content.english: 110:3 His work is praise and magnificence: * and his justice continueth for ever and ever.

segments.t: Conféssio et magnificéntia opus eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.

content.latin: 110:4 Memóriam fecit mirabílium suórum, miséricors et miserátor Dóminus: * escam dedit timéntibus se.
content.english: 110:4 He hath made a remembrance of his wonderful works, being a merciful and gracious Lord: * he hath given food to them that fear him.

segments.t: Memóriam fecit mirabílium suórum, miséricors et miserátor Dóminus: * escam dedit timéntibus se.

content.latin: 110:5 Memor erit in sǽculum testaménti sui: * virtútem óperum suórum annuntiábit pópulo suo:
content.english: 110:5 He will be mindful for ever of his covenant: * he will shew forth to his people the power of his works.

segments.t: Memor erit in sǽculum testaménti sui: * virtútem óperum suórum annuntiábit pópulo suo:

content.latin: 110:7 Ut det illis hereditátem géntium: * ópera mánuum eius véritas, et iudícium.
content.english: 110:7 That he may give them the inheritance of the Gentiles: * the works of his hands are truth and judgment.

segments.t: Ut det illis hereditátem géntium: * ópera mánuum eius véritas, et iudícium.

content.latin: 110:8 Fidélia ómnia mandáta eius: confirmáta in sǽculum sǽculi, * facta in veritáte et æquitáte.
content.english: 110:8 All his commandments are faithful: confirmed for ever and ever, * made in truth and equity.

segments.t: Fidélia ómnia mandáta eius: confirmáta in sǽculum sǽculi, * facta in veritáte et æquitáte.

content.latin: 110:9 Redemptiónem misit pópulo suo: * mandávit in ætérnum testaméntum suum.
content.english: 110:9 He hath sent redemption to his people: * he hath commanded his covenant for ever.

segments.t: Redemptiónem misit pópulo suo: * mandávit in ætérnum testaméntum suum.

content.english: 110:9 (bow head) Holy and terrible is his name: * the fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.

segments.t: 110:9 (fit reverentia)

content.latin: 110:10 Intelléctus bonus ómnibus faciéntibus eum: * laudátio eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
content.english: 110:10 A good understanding to all that do it: * his praise continueth for ever and ever.

segments.t: Intelléctus bonus ómnibus faciéntibus eum: * laudátio eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
