segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Redemptiónem misit Dóminus pópulo suo: mandávit in ætérnum testaméntum suum.
content.english: Ant. The Lord sent redemption unto His people, He hath commanded His covenant for ever.

segments.t: Ant.
Redemptiónem misit Dóminus pópulo suo: mandávit in ætérnum testaméntum suum.

content.latin: Ant. Exórtum est * in ténebris lumen rectis corde: miséricors, et miserátor, et iustus Dóminus.
content.english: Ant. Unto the upright there ariseth * light in the darkness; the Lord is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

segments.t: Ant.
Exórtum est * in ténebris lumen rectis corde: miséricors, et miserátor, et iustus Dóminus.

content.latin: Psalmus 111 [3]
content.english: Psalm 111 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 111

content.latin: 111:1 Beátus vir, qui timet Dóminum: * in mandátis eius volet nimis.
content.english: 111:1 Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord: * he shall delight exceedingly in his commandments.

segments.t: Beátus vir, qui timet Dóminum: * in mandátis eius volet nimis.

content.latin: 111:2 Potens in terra erit semen eius: * generátio rectórum benedicétur.
content.english: 111:2 His seed shall be mighty upon earth: * the generation of the righteous shall be blessed.

segments.t: Potens in terra erit semen eius: * generátio rectórum benedicétur.

content.latin: 111:3 Glória, et divítiæ in domo eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
content.english: 111:3 Glory and wealth shall be in his house: * and his justice remaineth for ever and ever.

segments.t: Glória, et divítiæ in domo eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.

content.latin: 111:4 Exórtum est in ténebris lumen rectis: * miséricors, et miserátor, et iustus.
content.english: 111:4 To the righteous a light is risen up in darkness: * he is merciful, and compassionate and just.

segments.t: Exórtum est in ténebris lumen rectis: * miséricors, et miserátor, et iustus.

content.latin: 111:5 Iucúndus homo qui miserétur et cómmodat, dispónet sermónes suos in iudício: * quia in ætérnum non commovébitur.
content.english: 111:5 Acceptable is the man that sheweth mercy and lendeth: he shall order his words with judgment: * because he shall not be moved for ever.

segments.t: Iucúndus homo qui miserétur et cómmodat, dispónet sermónes suos in iudício: * quia in ætérnum non commovébitur.

content.latin: 111:7 In memória ætérna erit iustus: * ab auditióne mala non timébit.
content.english: 111:7 The just shall be in everlasting remembrance: * he shall not fear the evil hearing.

segments.t: In memória ætérna erit iustus: * ab auditióne mala non timébit.

content.latin: 111:7 Parátum cor eius speráre in Dómino, confirmátum est cor eius: * non commovébitur donec despíciat inimícos suos.
content.english: 111:7 His heart is ready to hope in the Lord: his heart is strengthened, * he shall not be moved until he look over his enemies.

segments.t: Parátum cor eius speráre in Dómino, confirmátum est cor eius: * non commovébitur donec despíciat inimícos suos.

content.latin: 111:9 Dispérsit, dedit paupéribus: iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi, * cornu eius exaltábitur in glória.
content.english: 111:9 He hath distributed, he hath given to the poor: his justice remaineth for ever and ever: * his horn shall be exalted in glory.

segments.t: Dispérsit, dedit paupéribus: iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi, * cornu eius exaltábitur in glória.

content.latin: 111:10 Peccátor vidébit, et irascétur, déntibus suis fremet et tabéscet: * desidérium peccatórum períbit.
content.english: 111:10 The wicked shall see, and shall be angry, he shall gnash with his teeth and pine away: * the desire of the wicked shall perish.

segments.t: Peccátor vidébit, et irascétur, déntibus suis fremet et tabéscet: * desidérium peccatórum períbit.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.latin: Ant. Apud Dóminum * misericórdia, et copiósa apud eum redémptio.
content.english: Ant. With the Lord * there is mercy, and with Him is plenteous redemption.

segments.t: Ant.
Apud Dóminum * misericórdia, et copiósa apud eum redémptio.

content.latin: Psalmus 129 [4]
content.english: Psalm 129 [4]

segments.t: Psalmus 129

content.latin: 129:1 De profúndis clamávi ad te, Dómine: * Dómine, exáudi vocem meam:
content.english: 129:1 Out of the depths I have cried to thee, O Lord: * Lord, hear my voice.

segments.t: De profúndis clamávi ad te, Dómine: * Dómine, exáudi vocem meam:

content.latin: 129:2 Fiant aures tuæ intendéntes, * in vocem deprecatiónis meæ.
content.english: 129:2 Let thy ears be attentive * to the voice of my supplication.

segments.t: Fiant aures tuæ intendéntes, * in vocem deprecatiónis meæ.

content.latin: 129:3 Si iniquitátes observáveris, Dómine: * Dómine, quis sustinébit?
content.english: 129:3 If thou, O Lord, wilt mark iniquities: * Lord, who shall stand it.

segments.t: Si iniquitátes observáveris, Dómine: * Dómine, quis sustinébit?

content.latin: 129:4 Quia apud te propitiátio est: * et propter legem tuam sustínui te, Dómine.
content.english: 129:4 For with thee there is merciful forgiveness: * and by reason of thy law, I have waited for thee, O Lord.

segments.t: Quia apud te propitiátio est: * et propter legem tuam sustínui te, Dómine.

content.latin: 129:5 Sustínuit ánima mea in verbo eius: * sperávit ánima mea in Dómino.
content.english: 129:5 My soul hath relied on his word: * my soul hath hoped in the Lord.

segments.t: Sustínuit ánima mea in verbo eius: * sperávit ánima mea in Dómino.

content.latin: 129:6 A custódia matutína usque ad noctem: * speret Israël in Dómino.
content.english: 129:6 From the morning watch even until night, * let Israel hope in the Lord.

segments.t: A custódia matutína usque ad noctem: * speret Israël in Dómino.

content.latin: 129:7 Quia apud Dóminum misericórdia: * et copiósa apud eum redémptio.
content.english: 129:7 Because with the Lord there is mercy: * and with him plentiful redemption.

segments.t: Quia apud Dóminum misericórdia: * et copiósa apud eum redémptio.

content.latin: 129:8 Et ipse rédimet Israël, * ex ómnibus iniquitátibus eius.
content.english: 129:8 And he shall redeem Israel * from all his iniquities.

segments.t: Et ipse rédimet Israël, * ex ómnibus iniquitátibus eius.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.english: Ant. With the Lord there is mercy, and with Him is plenteous redemption.

segments.t: Ant.
Apud Dóminum misericórdia, et copiósa apud eum redémptio.

content.latin: Ant. De fructu * ventris tui ponam super sedem tuam.
content.english: Ant. Of the fruit * of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

segments.t: Ant.
De fructu * ventris tui ponam super sedem tuam.

content.latin: Psalmus 131 [5]
content.english: Psalm 131 [5]

segments.t: Psalmus 131

content.latin: 131:1 Meménto, Dómine, David, * et omnis mansuetúdinis eius:
content.english: 131:1 Lord, remember David, * and all his meekness.

segments.t: Meménto, Dómine, David, * et omnis mansuetúdinis eius:

content.latin: 131:2 Sicut iurávit Dómino, * votum vovit Deo Iacob:
content.english: 131:2 How he swore to the Lord, * he vowed a vow to the God of Jacob:

segments.t: Sicut iurávit Dómino, * votum vovit Deo Iacob:

content.latin: 131:3 Si introíero in tabernáculum domus meæ, * si ascéndero in lectum strati mei:
content.english: 131:3 If I shall enter into the tabernacle of my house: * if I shall go up into the bed wherein I lie:

segments.t: Si introíero in tabernáculum domus meæ, * si ascéndero in lectum strati mei:

content.latin: 131:4 Si dédero somnum óculis meis, * et pálpebris meis dormitatiónem:
content.english: 131:4 If I shall give sleep to my eyes, * or slumber to my eyelids,

segments.t: Si dédero somnum óculis meis, * et pálpebris meis dormitatiónem:

content.latin: 131:5 Et réquiem tempóribus meis: donec invéniam locum Dómino, * tabernáculum Deo Iacob.
content.english: 131:5 Or rest to my temples: until I find out a place for the Lord, * a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.

segments.t: Et réquiem tempóribus meis: donec invéniam locum Dómino, * tabernáculum Deo Iacob.

content.latin: 131:6 Ecce, audívimus eam in Éphrata: * invénimus eam in campis silvæ.
content.english: 131:6 Behold we have heard of it in Ephrata: * we have found it in the fields of the wood.

segments.t: Ecce, audívimus eam in Éphrata: * invénimus eam in campis silvæ.

content.latin: 131:7 Introíbimus in tabernáculum eius: * adorábimus in loco, ubi stetérunt pedes eius.
content.english: 131:7 We will go into his tabernacle: * we will adore in the place where his feet stood.

segments.t: Introíbimus in tabernáculum eius: * adorábimus in loco, ubi stetérunt pedes eius.

content.latin: 131:8 Surge, Dómine, in réquiem tuam, * tu et arca sanctificatiónis tuæ.
content.english: 131:8 Arise, O Lord, into thy resting place: * thou and the ark, which thou hast sanctified.

segments.t: Surge, Dómine, in réquiem tuam, * tu et arca sanctificatiónis tuæ.

content.latin: 131:9 Sacerdótes tui induántur iustítiam: * et sancti tui exsúltent.
content.english: 131:9 Let thy priests be clothed with justice: * and let thy saints rejoice.

segments.t: Sacerdótes tui induántur iustítiam: * et sancti tui exsúltent.

content.latin: 131:10 Propter David, servum tuum, * non avértas fáciem Christi tui.
content.english: 131:10 For thy servant David’s sake, * turn not away the face of thy anointed.

segments.t: Propter David, servum tuum, * non avértas fáciem Christi tui.

content.latin: 131:11 Iurávit Dóminus David veritátem, et non frustrábitur eam: * De fructu ventris tui ponam super sedem tuam.
content.english: 131:11 The Lord hath sworn truth to David, and he will not make it void: * of the fruit of thy womb I will set upon thy throne.

segments.t: Iurávit Dóminus David veritátem, et non frustrábitur eam: * De fructu ventris tui ponam super sedem tuam.

content.latin: 131:12 Si custodíerint fílii tui testaméntum meum, * et testimónia mea hæc, quæ docébo eos:
content.english: 131:12 If thy children will keep my covenant, * and these my testimonies which I shall teach them:

segments.t: Si custodíerint fílii tui testaméntum meum, * et testimónia mea hæc, quæ docébo eos:

content.latin: 131:12 Et fílii eórum usque in sǽculum, * sedébunt super sedem tuam.
content.english: 131:12 Their children also for evermore * shall sit upon thy throne.

segments.t: Et fílii eórum usque in sǽculum, * sedébunt super sedem tuam.

content.latin: 131:13 Quóniam elégit Dóminus Sion: * elégit eam in habitatiónem sibi.
content.english: 131:13 For the Lord hath chosen Sion: * he hath chosen it for his dwelling.

segments.t: Quóniam elégit Dóminus Sion: * elégit eam in habitatiónem sibi.

content.latin: 131:14 Hæc réquies mea in sǽculum sǽculi: * hic habitábo quóniam elégi eam.
content.english: 131:14 This is my rest for ever and ever: * here will I dwell, for I have chosen it.

segments.t: Hæc réquies mea in sǽculum sǽculi: * hic habitábo quóniam elégi eam.

content.latin: 131:15 Víduam eius benedícens benedícam: * páuperes eius saturábo pánibus.
content.english: 131:15 Blessing I will bless her widow: * I will satisfy her poor with bread.

segments.t: Víduam eius benedícens benedícam: * páuperes eius saturábo pánibus.

content.latin: 131:16 Sacerdótes eius índuam salutári: * et sancti eius exsultatióne exsultábunt.
content.english: 131:16 I will clothe her priests with salvation: * and her saints shall rejoice with exceeding great joy.

segments.t: Sacerdótes eius índuam salutári: * et sancti eius exsultatióne exsultábunt.

content.latin: 131:17 Illuc prodúcam cornu David, * parávi lucérnam Christo meo.
content.english: 131:17 There will I bring forth a horn to David: * I have prepared a lamp for my anointed.

segments.t: Illuc prodúcam cornu David, * parávi lucérnam Christo meo.

content.latin: 131:18 Inimícos eius índuam confusióne: * super ipsum autem efflorébit sanctificátio mea.
content.english: 131:18 His enemies I will clothe with confusion: * but upon him shall my sanctification flourish.

segments.t: Inimícos eius índuam confusióne: * super ipsum autem efflorébit sanctificátio mea.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. De fructu ventris tui ponam super sedem tuam.
content.english: Ant. Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

segments.t: Ant.
De fructu ventris tui ponam super sedem tuam.

content.latin: Multifáriam, multísque modis olim Deus loquens pátribus in prophétis: novíssime diébus istis locútus est nobis in Fílio, quem constítuit herédem universórum, per quem fecit et sǽcula.
content.english: God, who, at sundry times and in diverse manners, spoke in times past to the fathers by the prophets, last of all, in these days hath spoken to us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the world.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: Hymnus
content.english: Hymn

segments.t: Hymnus

content.latin: Iesu, Redémptor ómnium,
content.english: Jesus, the Ransomer of man,

content.latin: Quem lucis ante oríginem
content.english: Who, ere created light began,

content.latin: Parem patérnæ glóriæ
content.english: Didst from the sovereign Father spring,

content.latin: Pater suprémus édidit.
content.english: His power and glory equalling.

content.latin: Tu lumen, et splendor Patris,
content.english: The Father’s Light and Splendor Thou,

content.latin: Tu spes perénnis ómnium,
content.english: Their endless hope to Thee that bow;

content.latin: Inténde quas fundunt preces
content.english: Accept the prayers and praise to-day

content.latin: Tui per orbem sérvuli.
content.english: That through the world Thy servants pay.

content.latin: Meménto, rerum Cónditor,
content.english: Salvation’s Author, call to mind

content.latin: Nostri quod olim córporis,
content.english: How, taking form of humankind,

content.latin: Sacráta ab alvo Vírginis
content.english: Born of a Virgin undefiled,

content.latin: Nascéndo, formam súmpseris.
content.english: Thou in man’s flesh becam’st a Child.

content.latin: Testátur hoc præsens dies,
content.english: Thus testifies the present day,

content.latin: Currens per anni círculum,
content.english: Through every year in long array,

content.latin: Quod solus e sinu Patris
content.english: That Thou, salvation’s source alone,

content.latin: Mundi salus advéneris.
content.english: Proceedest from the Father’s throne.

content.latin: Hunc astra, tellus, ǽquora,
content.english: The heavens above, the rolling main

content.latin: Hunc omne, quod cælo subest,
content.english: And all that earth’s wide realms contain,

content.latin: Salútis auctórem novæ
content.english: With joyous voice now loudly sing

content.latin: Novo salútat cántico.
content.english: The glory of their new-born King.

content.latin: Et nos, beáta quos sacri
content.english: And we who, by Thy precious Blood

content.latin: Rigávit unda sánguinis,
content.english: From sin redeemed, are marked for God,

content.latin: Natális ob diem tui
content.english: On this the day that saw Thy birth,

content.latin: Hymni tribútum sólvimus.
content.english: Sing the new song of ransomed earth.

content.latin: Iesu, tibi sit glória,
content.english: O Lord, the Virgin-born, to Thee

content.latin: Qui natus es de Vírgine,
content.english: Eternal praise and glory be,

content.latin: Cum Patre et almo Spíritu,
content.english: Whom with the Father we adore

content.latin: In sempitérna sǽcula.
content.english: And Holy Ghost forevermore.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Notum fecit Dóminus, allelúia.
content.english: ℣. The Lord hath made known, alleluia.

segments.t: Notum fecit Dóminus, allelúia.

content.latin: ℟. Salutáre suum, allelúia.
content.english: ℟. His salvation, alleluia.

segments.t: Salutáre suum, allelúia.

content.latin: Ant. Hódie * Christus natus est: hódie Salvátor appáruit: hódie in terra canunt Angeli, lætántur Archángeli: hódie exsúltant iusti, dicéntes: Glória in excélsis Deo, allelúia.
content.english: Ant. This day the Christ is born this day the Saviour is appeared; * this day the Angels sing praise in the earth and the Archangels rejoice; this day the righteous are glad and say: Glory to God in the highest. Alleluia.

segments.t: Ant.
Hódie * Christus natus est: hódie Salvátor appáruit: hódie in terra canunt Angeli, lætántur Archángeli: hódie exsúltant iusti, dicéntes: Glória in excélsis Deo, allelúia.

content.latin: Canticum B. Mariæ Virginis
content.english: Canticle of the Blessed Virgin

segments.t: Canticum B. Mariæ Virginis

content.latin: 1:46 Magníficat ✠ * ánima mea Dóminum.
content.english: 1:46 My soul ✠ * doth magnify the Lord.

segments.t: Magníficat ✠ * ánima mea Dóminum.

content.latin: 1:47 Et exsultávit spíritus meus: * in Deo, salutári meo.
content.english: 1:47 And my spirit hath rejoiced * in God my Saviour.

segments.t: Et exsultávit spíritus meus: * in Deo, salutári meo.

content.latin: 1:48 Quia respéxit humilitátem ancíllæ suæ: * ecce enim ex hoc beátam me dicent omnes generatiónes.
content.english: 1:48 Because he hath regarded the humility of his handmaid; * for behold from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

segments.t: Quia respéxit humilitátem ancíllæ suæ: * ecce enim ex hoc beátam me dicent omnes generatiónes.

content.latin: 1:49 Quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est: * et sanctum nomen eius.
content.english: 1:49 Because he that is mighty, hath done great things to me; * and holy is his name.

segments.t: Quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est: * et sanctum nomen eius.

content.latin: 1:50 Et misericórdia eius, a progénie in progénies: * timéntibus eum.
content.english: 1:50 And his mercy is from generation unto generations, * to them that fear him.

segments.t: Et misericórdia eius, a progénie in progénies: * timéntibus eum.

content.latin: 1:51 Fecit poténtiam in brácchio suo: * dispérsit supérbos mente cordis sui.
content.english: 1:51 He hath shewed might in his arm: * he hath scattered the proud in the conceit of their heart.

segments.t: Fecit poténtiam in brácchio suo: * dispérsit supérbos mente cordis sui.

content.latin: 1:52 Depósuit poténtes de sede: * et exaltávit húmiles.
content.english: 1:52 He hath put down the mighty from their seat, * and hath exalted the humble.

segments.t: Depósuit poténtes de sede: * et exaltávit húmiles.

content.latin: 1:53 Esuriéntes implévit bonis: * et dívites dimísit inánes.
content.english: 1:53 He hath filled the hungry with good things; * and the rich he hath sent empty away.

segments.t: Esuriéntes implévit bonis: * et dívites dimísit inánes.

content.latin: 1:54 Suscépit Israël púerum suum: * recordátus misericórdiæ suæ.
content.english: 1:54 He hath received Israel his servant, * being mindful of his mercy:

segments.t: Suscépit Israël púerum suum: * recordátus misericórdiæ suæ.

content.latin: 1:55 Sicut locútus est ad patres nostros: * Ábraham, et sémini eius in sǽcula.
content.english: 1:55 As he spoke to our fathers, * to Abraham and to his seed for ever.

segments.t: Sicut locútus est ad patres nostros: * Ábraham, et sémini eius in sǽcula.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum: advéniat regnum tuum: fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris: et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem: sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.
content.english: Our Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation: But deliver us from evil. Amen.

content.latin: Confíteor Deo omnipoténti, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírgini, beáto Michaéli Archángelo, beáto Ioánni Baptístæ, sanctis Apóstolis Petro et Paulo, et ómnibus Sanctis, quia peccávi nimis, cogitatióne, verbo et ópere: percutit sibi pectus mea culpa, mea culpa, mea máxima culpa. Ídeo precor beátam Maríam semper Vírginem, beátum Michaélem Archángelum, beátum Ioánnem Baptístam, sanctos Apóstolos Petrum et Paulum, et omnes Sanctos, oráre pro me ad Dóminum Deum nostrum.
content.english: I confess to almighty God, to blessed Mary ever Virgin, to blessed Michael the Archangel, to blessed John the Baptist, to the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and to all the Saints, that I have sinned exceedingly in thought, word and deed: strikes his breast through my fault, through my fault, through my most grievous fault. Therefore I beseech blessed Mary ever Virgin, blessed Michael the Archangel, blessed John the Baptist, the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and all the Saints, to pray for me to the Lord our God.

segments.t: Confíteor Deo omnipoténti, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírgini, beáto Michaéli Archángelo, beáto Ioánni Baptístæ, sanctis Apóstolis Petro et Paulo, et ómnibus Sanctis, quia peccávi nimis, cogitatióne, verbo et ópere:

content.latin: 90:1 Qui hábitat in adiutório Altíssimi, * in protectióne Dei cæli commorábitur.
content.english: 90:1 He that dwelleth in the aid of the most High, * shall abide under the protection of the God of Jacob.

segments.t: Qui hábitat in adiutório Altíssimi, * in protectióne Dei cæli commorábitur.

content.latin: 90:2 Dicet Dómino: Suscéptor meus es tu, et refúgium meum: * Deus meus sperábo in eum.
content.english: 90:2 He shall say to the Lord: Thou art my protector, and my refuge: * my God, in him will I trust.

segments.t: Dicet Dómino: Suscéptor meus es tu, et refúgium meum: * Deus meus sperábo in eum.

content.latin: 90:3 Quóniam ipse liberávit me de láqueo venántium, * et a verbo áspero.
content.english: 90:3 For he hath delivered me from the snare of the hunters: * and from the sharp word.

segments.t: Quóniam ipse liberávit me de láqueo venántium, * et a verbo áspero.

content.latin: 90:4 Scápulis suis obumbrábit tibi: * et sub pennis eius sperábis.
content.english: 90:4 He will overshadow thee with his shoulders: * and under his wings thou shalt trust.

segments.t: Scápulis suis obumbrábit tibi: * et sub pennis eius sperábis.

content.latin: 90:5 Scuto circúmdabit te véritas eius: * non timébis a timóre noctúrno,
content.english: 90:5 His truth shall compass thee with a shield: * thou shalt not be afraid of the terror of the night.

segments.t: Scuto circúmdabit te véritas eius: * non timébis a timóre noctúrno,

content.latin: 90:6 A sagítta volánte in die, a negótio perambulánte in ténebris: * ab incúrsu, et dæmónio meridiáno.
content.english: 90:6 Of the arrow that flieth in the day, of the business that walketh about in the dark: * of invasion, or of the noonday devil.

segments.t: A sagítta volánte in die, a negótio perambulánte in ténebris: * ab incúrsu, et dæmónio meridiáno.

content.latin: 90:7 Cadent a látere tuo mille, et decem míllia a dextris tuis: * ad te autem non appropinquábit.
content.english: 90:7 A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand: * but it shall not come nigh thee.

segments.t: Cadent a látere tuo mille, et decem míllia a dextris tuis: * ad te autem non appropinquábit.

content.latin: 90:8 Verúmtamen óculis tuis considerábis: * et retributiónem peccatórum vidébis.
content.english: 90:8 But thou shalt consider with thy eyes: * and shalt see the reward of the wicked.

segments.t: Verúmtamen óculis tuis considerábis: * et retributiónem peccatórum vidébis.

content.latin: 90:9 Quóniam tu es, Dómine, spes mea: * Altíssimum posuísti refúgium tuum.
content.english: 90:9 Because thou, O Lord, art my hope: * thou hast made the most High thy refuge.

segments.t: Quóniam tu es, Dómine, spes mea: * Altíssimum posuísti refúgium tuum.

content.latin: 90:10 Non accédet ad te malum: * et flagéllum non appropinquábit tabernáculo tuo.
content.english: 90:10 There shall no evil come to thee: * nor shall the scourge come near thy dwelling.

segments.t: Non accédet ad te malum: * et flagéllum non appropinquábit tabernáculo tuo.

content.latin: 90:11 Quóniam Ángelis suis mandávit de te: * ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
content.english: 90:11 For he hath given his angels charge over thee; * to keep thee in all thy ways.

segments.t: Quóniam Ángelis suis mandávit de te: * ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.

content.latin: 90:12 In mánibus portábunt te: * ne forte offéndas ad lápidem pedem tuum.

segments.t: In mánibus portábunt te: * ne forte offéndas ad lápidem pedem tuum.

content.latin: 90:13 Super áspidem, et basilíscum ambulábis: * et conculcábis leónem et dracónem.
content.english: 90:13 Thou shalt walk upon the asp and the basilisk: * and thou shalt trample under foot the lion and the dragon.

segments.t: Super áspidem, et basilíscum ambulábis: * et conculcábis leónem et dracónem.

content.latin: 90:14 Quóniam in me sperávit, liberábo eum: * prótegam eum, quóniam cognóvit nomen meum.
content.english: 90:14 Because he hoped in me I will deliver him: * I will protect him because he hath known my name.

segments.t: Quóniam in me sperávit, liberábo eum: * prótegam eum, quóniam cognóvit nomen meum.

content.latin: 90:15 Clamábit ad me, et ego exáudiam eum: * cum ipso sum in tribulatióne: erípiam eum et glorificábo eum.

segments.t: Clamábit ad me, et ego exáudiam eum: * cum ipso sum in tribulatióne: erípiam eum et glorificábo eum.

segments.t: Comméndo spíritum meum.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. In manus tuas, Dómine, * Comméndo spíritum meum.
content.english: ℟. Into thy hands, O Lord, * do I commend my spirit.

segments.t: In manus tuas, Dómine, * Comméndo spíritum meum.

content.latin: ℣. Custódi nos, Dómine, ut pupíllam óculi.
content.english: ℣. Keep us, Lord, as the apple of thine eye.

segments.t: Custódi nos, Dómine, ut pupíllam óculi.

content.latin: ℟. Sub umbra alárum tuárum prótege nos.
content.english: ℟. Protect us under the shadow of thy wings.

segments.t: Sub umbra alárum tuárum prótege nos.

content.latin: Ant. Salva nos, * Dómine, vigilántes, custódi nos dormiéntes; ut vigilémus cum Christo, et requiescámus in pace.
content.english: Ant. Protect us, * Lord, while we are awake and safeguard us while we sleep; that we may keep watch with Christ, and rest in peace.

segments.t: Ant.
Salva nos, * Dómine, vigilántes, custódi nos dormiéntes; ut vigilémus cum Christo, et requiescámus in pace.

content.latin: Canticum Simeonis
content.english: Canticle of Simeon

segments.t: Canticum Simeonis

content.latin: 2:29 Nunc dimíttis ✠ servum tuum, Dómine, * secúndum verbum tuum in pace:
content.english: 2:29 Now thou dost dismiss thy servant, O Lord, ✠ * according to thy word in peace;

segments.t: Nunc dimíttis ✠ servum tuum, Dómine, * secúndum verbum tuum in pace:

content.latin: 2:30 Quia vidérunt óculi mei * salutáre tuum,
content.english: 2:30 Because my eyes have seen * thy salvation,

segments.t: Quia vidérunt óculi mei * salutáre tuum,

content.latin: 2:31 Quod parásti * ante fáciem ómnium populórum,
content.english: 2:31 Which thou hast prepared * before the face of all peoples:

segments.t: Quod parásti * ante fáciem ómnium populórum,

content.latin: 2:32 Lumen ad revelatiónem géntium, * et glóriam plebis tuæ Israël.
content.english: 2:32 A light to the revelation of the Gentiles, * and the glory of thy people Israel.

segments.t: Lumen ad revelatiónem géntium, * et glóriam plebis tuæ Israël.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Salva nos, Dómine, vigilántes, custódi nos dormiéntes; ut vigilémus cum Christo, et requiescámus in pace.
content.english: Ant. Protect us, Lord, while we are awake and safeguard us while we sleep; that we may keep watch with Christ, and rest in peace.

segments.t: Ant.
Salva nos, Dómine, vigilántes, custódi nos dormiéntes; ut vigilémus cum Christo, et requiescámus in pace.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Vísita, quǽsumus, Dómine, habitatiónem istam, et omnes insídias inimíci ab ea longe repélle: Ángeli tui sancti hábitent in ea, qui nos in pace custódiant; et benedíctio tua sit super nos semper.
content.english: Visit, we beseech thee, O Lord, this dwelling, and drive far from it the snares of the enemy; let thy holy angels dwell herein to preserve us in peace, and let thy blessing be always upon us.

content.latin: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: ℣. Benedicámus Dómino.
content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedicámus Dómino.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: Benedictio. Benedícat et custódiat nos omnípotens et miséricors Dóminus, ✠ Pater, et Fílius, et Spíritus Sanctus.
content.english: Benediction. The almighty and merciful Lord, ✠ the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit, bless us and keep us.

segments.t: Benedictio.
Benedícat et custódiat nos omnípotens et miséricors Dóminus, ✠ Pater, et Fílius, et Spíritus Sanctus.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: Alma Redemptóris Mater, quæ pérvia cæli
content.english: Mother of Christ, hear thou thy people's cry

content.latin: Porta manes, et stella maris, succúrre cadénti,
content.english: Star of the deep and Portal of the sky!

content.latin: Súrgere qui curat, pópulo: tu quæ genuísti,
content.english: Mother of Him who thee from nothing made.

content.latin: Natúra miránte, tuum sanctum Genitórem,
content.english: Sinking we strive and call to thee for aid:

content.latin: Virgo prius ac postérius, Gabriélis ab ore
content.english: O, by what joy which Gabriel brought to thee,

content.latin: Sumens illud Ave, peccatórum miserére.
content.english: Thou Virgin first and last, let us thy mercy see.

content.latin: ℣. Post partum, Virgo, invioláta permansísti.
content.english: ℣. After childbirth thou didst remain a virgin.

segments.t: Post partum, Virgo, invioláta permansísti.

content.latin: ℟. Dei Génetrix, intercéde pro nobis.
content.english: ℟. Intercede for us, O Mother of God.

segments.t: Dei Génetrix, intercéde pro nobis.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Deus, qui salútis ætérnæ, beátæ Maríæ virginitáte fecúnda, humáno géneri prǽmia præstitísti: tríbue, quǽsumus; ut ipsam pro nobis intercédere sentiámus, per quam merúimus auctórem vitæ suscípere, Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum. Amen.
content.english: O God, who, by the fruitful virginity of blessed Mary, hast bestowed upon mankind the reward of eternal salvation: grant, we beseech thee, that we may experience her intercession, through whom we have been made worthy to receive the author of life, Our Lord Jesus Christ thy Son. Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Divínum auxílium ✠ máneat semper nobíscum.
content.english: ℣. May the divine assistance ✠ remain with us always.

segments.t: Divínum auxílium ✠ máneat semper nobíscum.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.
